scenario: first-use setup without a project, new settings
what_it_is: Agent-operated development evidence on an identified development build: the opening of the first-use setup page, up to and not including the App's own confirmation. It is neither setup completed nor a person's observation. It starts no Codex and needs no sign-in.
starting_state: An identified candidate built from main; a new throwaway home made by the launcher for this launch; no App data; the App running and confirmed from the shell; no child process.
acts: views and clicks only; nothing is typed, no file or folder is chosen, no confirmation is answered
never_clicked: Create settings and save for next launch…

steps.says: the page a new person first sees; Review setup is unavailable, with its reason, before any choice

expect.text: Choose the folder you want to work in, or continue without a project.

steps.says: setup is required and the App's data folder is under the throwaway home
no project is chosen; the page is ready to review

expect.text: No project for now. You can still have conversations, and choose a project later in Desktop setup.
Ready to review. Nothing is created or saved until you confirm.

steps.says: what setup will do, in five lines, and the control that would confirm it

expect.text: Create a new settings folder for this App, inside its data folder
In it, create an empty config.toml, an empty AGENTS.md and an empty skills folder
Create a new sign-in folder for this App, linked to those settings
Project when you next open the App: none
Save these choices privately for the next launch
Nothing is created until you confirm. No other Codex settings, home or credential is read, imported or changed.

expect.button: Create settings and save for next launch…

steps.says: three locations, each under the App's data folder in the throwaway home
the review closes; nothing was confirmed

expect.button: Create settings and save for next launch…

expect.text: Ready to review. Nothing is created or saved until you confirm.

steps.says: with existing settings and nothing chosen, Review setup is unavailable again, with its reason

expect.text: Choose your config.toml, AGENTS.md and skills folder, or start with new settings.

steps.says: back to new settings; the page is ready to review again

expect.text: Ready to review. Nothing is created or saved until you confirm.
